title: Angle-resolved photoemission using the circularly polarized light in Pb-Bi2212
abstract: In a recent preprint Campuzano et al.(cond-mat/0309402), have questioned the validity of our ARPES results (cond-mat/0305179) contradicting the interpretation of earlier photoemission experiments in terms of the time-reversal symmetry breaking in Bi2212. Here we highlight the principal results of our study and refute all the criticism.
